tools.description: Search the official Redpanda documentation and return the most relevant sections from it for a user query. tools.name: list_api_reference_pages
tools.description:
List pages in Redpanda API reference documentation. Returns endpoints, schemas, and topic pages with URL, title, type, and description.

SCOPING (important for accurate results):
- api="all" or omit: Lists all available APIs
- api="admin": Cluster management operations (brokers, partitions, configs,

tools.name: search_api_reference
tools.description:
Search Redpanda API reference documentation by keyword. Returns up to 20 matching endpoints, schemas, or topics with URL, title, and text excerpts.

SCOPING (important for accurate results):
- api="all" or omit: Search across ALL APIs at once - useful when unsure which API contains the endpoint
- ap

tools.name: get_api_reference_content
tools.description:
Retrieve full content of API reference pages by URL. Returns complete endpoint details including parameters, request/response schemas, and examples.

Use this after finding pages via list_api_reference_pages or search_api_reference. Pass the URLs from those results directly.

Returns up to 10 pages

tools.name: submit_documentation_feedback
tools.description:
Send feedback about the Redpanda documentation or products directly to the Redpanda team.

If the user hits a bug, a documentation gap, incorrect or missing information, or expresses frustration while using Redpanda, ASK whether they'd like to send feedback to the Redpanda team. Only call this tool

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_redpanda_question, list_api_reference_pages, search_api_reference, get_api_reference_content · Public sink: submit_documentation_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_redpanda_question, list_api_reference_pages, search_api_reference, get_api_reference_content · Public sink: submit_documentation_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_redpanda_question" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
